basics.name: Vatsal Trivedi
basics.label: Forward Deployed Engineer · AI Platforms · Enterprise Integrations
basics.summary: Forward Deployed Engineer who embeds with the problem, ships into production, and owns the integrations that make AI systems useful inside real enterprises. Work spans LLM orchestration, multi-tenant SaaS, compliance-aware pipelines, and deep enterprise integrations — where production uptime, audit trails, and regulated workflows are the bar.

work.name: Phamax
work.description: Ariya — AI platform for pharma covering content generation, research, analytics, and engagement.
work.summary: Leading engineering for Ariya, an AI platform for pharmaceutical content workflows, research, analytics, and engagement. Designing and delivering scalable, compliant systems that connect generative AI with enterprise ecosystems.
highlights: Architecting core systems for an AI platform serving global pharmaceutical clients across content creation, research, analytics, and engagement.
Built the AI Content Wizard and content lifecycle system covering authoring, multi-stage approval, compliance validation, and omnichannel distribution across regulated markets.
Designed and deployed LLM orchestration covering prompt engineering, context injection, RAG pipelines, embedding retrieval, and tool calling for compliant, traceable content generation.
Integrated Veeva CRM and Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) to support compliant omnichannel workflows across multiple client tenants.
Led development of a centralized Data Catalog for metadata-driven discovery, observability, and self-serve data access across business and engineering teams.
Implemented production architecture with full auditability, deployment pipelines, monitoring, and optimized AI/data workflows using caching and vector databases.

work.name: Comviva
work.description: MobiLytix Rewards — engagement marketing for loyalty programs and promotional campaigns.
work.summary: Technical lead for MobiLytix Rewards, an engagement marketing product powering loyalty programs and promotional campaigns across industries.
highlights: Led modernization of MobiLytix Rewards into a cloud-agnostic, multi-tenant SaaS product with AI/ML-driven personalization for enterprise clients in telecom and retail.
Drove full-stack architecture and feature development using TypeScript, React, FeathersJS, Delta Lake, Postgres, and vector databases across a distributed microservices system.
Owned event-driven campaign execution with Kafka, handling high-throughput reward and loyalty workflows with asynchronous processing and caching.
Introduced observability and monitoring standards across the platform, improving deployment reliability and reducing mean time to resolution for production incidents.
Delivered measurable gains in user engagement and campaign performance through data-driven personalization and ML-driven segmentation.

work.name: Comviva
work.description: MobiLytix Digital Marketing — omni-channel marketing automation.
work.summary: Built integrations and analytics for an omni-channel marketing automation platform helping enterprises engage customers across digital touchpoints.
highlights: Delivered 14+ integrations including Shopify Public App, SeatGeek, HubSpot, AWS QuickSight, GoodData, Matomo, WooCommerce, WordPress, Batch Push, and Unlayer Editor.
Implemented ML-driven insights using Google BigQuery and GoodData for personalized campaign optimization.
Improved performance through query optimization, caching, and CDN strategies.
Resolved multi-tenant data isolation, API rate limiting, and secure credential handling across third-party platforms.

work.name: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS)
work.description: Life sciences digital transformation for global clients.
work.summary: Delivered digital transformation solutions for global life sciences clients, building full-stack applications and data-driven tools in a regulated enterprise environment.
highlights: Developed and delivered full-stack applications using React, Angular, Node.js, and Express.
Enabled business collaboration with Microsoft 365 including SharePoint, Teams, Power Automate, and Power BI.
Built analytics and reporting workflows using GA360, Google Tag Manager, and Data Studio for enterprise life sciences teams.

volunteer.summary: Leading design for the GDG Ahmedabad chapter: event visuals, branding assets, and social media graphics for community events.
Mentored open-source contributors during GirlScript Summer of Code 2020, guiding project architecture, code reviews, and development practices.

projects.name: InboxCraft
projects.description: Client-side tool that generates PowerShell scripts to automate Microsoft 365 Outlook inbox rules — no sign-up, no backend, fully transparent script execution.
highlights: Quick Mode and Advanced Mode workflows with a template library for services like GitHub, Slack, and Jira.
AST-based PowerShell code generation with syntax highlighting; entirely client-side for security and transparency.
Published as an official Agent Skills package compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, and assistants following the Vercel Labs skills spec; available via npx skills.

projects.name: InboxCraft Skills
projects.description: Official agent skill pack for InboxCraft — nine PowerShell-based tools for managing Outlook rules, folders, and categories via natural language.
highlights: Compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, and assistants following the npx skills specification.
Covers rule creation, folder hierarchy visualization, category management, large folder detection, and empty folder cleanup.

projects.name: StaleGuard
projects.description: Zero-friction stale deployment detector — silently reloads outdated SPA builds on tab focus by monitoring HTTP ETag/Last-Modified headers, with no polling or user banners.
highlights: Focus-triggered version checking with ETag and Last-Modified fallback; offline-safe.
Deployed to Azure Static Web Apps and GitHub Pages with automated GitHub Actions workflow.

projects.name: PySecRecipes
projects.description: Production-ready GitHub Actions workflow for automated Python dependency security audits — weekly scans, vulnerability reporting, and intelligent issue lifecycle management.
highlights: Scans against PyPI Advisory, OSV, and Python Packaging Advisory databases; generates detailed remediation reports.
Auto-creates and closes GitHub issues as vulnerabilities appear and are resolved; supports monorepos and multi-environment setups.

projects.name: PyImportSync
projects.description: AST-based Python dependency validator that ensures imports in a codebase are declared in requirements.txt — available as a GitHub Action and pre-commit hook.
highlights: Git-aware caching and configurable analysis paths for fast execution in CI/CD pipelines.
Cross-platform support via shell and PowerShell scripts; integrates with UV package manager.
